_doc: Hoenn overworld build config for b2tools/world.py (decision 2026-10-06: one Hoenn matrix, one exterior area). Map positions come from data/hoenn_world_layout.json (Sapphire's connections). Only maps listed under 'maps' are built; their cells and a one-cell ring around them go into the matrix, other tiles become forest.
_map_order_doc: Order of the connected maps for b2tools/world.py (outdoor sweep 2026-10-07): a cell takes the zone of its map with most tiles (a town first), a ring cell its busiest neighbour's; ties go to the first map in this order. It used to be the order the config files happened to add maps in, so enabling a building group (towns5) flipped Route 112/113's cell (7,2) and a sea cell to other zones. This is that old order, frozen; maps not listed come after it.

alt_layouts._doc: Other layouts of a map (Sapphire setmaplayoutindex) as Black 2 map replacements: b2tools/world.py build_alts builds the cells that change, patches/hoenn_world.py swaps their chunks (a/0/1/0 kind 0) while map replace event 'event' is set (uid 7 = work 0x4038 == 0x408; data/story_ids.json WORK_MAP_REPLACE_7_SKY_PILLAR). Route 131: Sapphire swaps in layout 320 (the Sky Pillar islet and its cave door) in its OnTransition once FLAG_SYS_GAME_CLEAR is set (src/field_scripts/scenes/Route131*.inc). Route 130: Sapphire swaps in layout 46 (LAYOUT_UNREFERENCED_MAP, Mirage Island) in its OnTransition on days the island is there (IsMirageIslandPresent), else layout 264 (its map.json's): map replace event 2 (work 0x4033 == 0x206; Black 2's own event-2 entries patch matrix 175 only, which no Hoenn zone uses, and no Black 2 script or code sets or reads event 2), src/field_scripts/scenes/Route130*.inc. Route 103: Emerald's Altering Cave mouth after the game (data/hoenn_map_additions.json LAYOUT_ROUTE103_ALTERING_CAVE; Emerald's Route103_OnLoad opens it once FLAG_SYS_GAME_CLEAR is set): event 7, the game-clear event of Route 131's islet (postgame_maps, 2026-10-07).

retile._doc: Sapphire draws the islet as one brown rock mountain (Pacifidlog tileset cliffs, its summit sand and pebbles out of reach): Black 2's mountain (heights.py: brown rock top gake_michi, rock lip gake1_0, tall face yamagake01, terraces)

Sapphire draws Mirage Island as a plateau ringed by cliffs with stairs up its south face, but its top (elevation 3, like the beach) meets the sea along its north rim (row 2: grass with a rock lip, metatile 0x002) and at two NW/NE corners, where Gen 3 would land a surfer straight onto it; heights.py keeps a region that touches the sea at sea level, so the island came out flat (no faces, the stairs level). The rim tiles become cliff faces: the top rises with the stairs (one level a row) and is reached by them only (outdoor_check accepts the lost landing).

the last column of the west and east cliffs, where they stand in the shallow-water ring (metatiles 0x166 / 0x167, labelled rock in gTileset_General for other maps' sea rocks): part of the face, not loose rocks

Route103._doc: heights_box (map tiles x0, y0, x1, y1): only the mouth, its rock and the new land strip may change height; the rest of Route 103 keeps the main layout's (the strip, a new sea shore, moved heights.py's nearest-shore split of the sea west of it by 1-3 tiles)

Route101._place_display_doc: zone header place-name display type (GetZoneLocNameDispType, arm9 0x02018ccc; CheckPopupPlaceNameDispAuto, ov036 0x021b5b40: 0 never pops up, 1 always, 3 not on Continue). Sapphire hides Route 101's popup until Birch's rescue is over (FLAG_HIDE_MAP_NAME_POPUP, data/maps/Route101/scripts.inc); here the rescue trigger on the first row started its message while the banner was opening, so a blank banner flashed (exterior sweep 2026-10-06). Black 2 has no flag for it, so Route 101 never pops up.
